 Order
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that in view of the subsequent development happened during the pendency of this writ petition, nothing survives in this writ petition and sought to dismiss the writ petition as infructuous. 
2. In view of the above, this Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous. 
3. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed. 
4. There shall be no order as to costs.
